values_mathematically_equal.meaning: the two compared floating point numbers are mathematically equal though their bit representations differ

exponents_equal.meaning: the two compared numbers have equal exponents so the main comparison branch is entered

le_result.meaning: the boolean returned by le(a,b) for the compared pair

gt_result.meaning: the boolean returned by gt(a,b) for the same compared pair

assumptions: le() and gt() are invoked on the same ordered pair of operands.
The comparison outcome is observable as the boolean return values of le() and gt().

unresolved.description: The report states the complement relation !(a > b) == a <= b but does not give the concrete return values or operand order, so the exact negation relation between le_result and gt_result cannot be bound to a numeric/boolean identity beyond the equality of the two observed results.

limitations: The plan formalizes only the le()/gt() complement consistency impact; the separate operand-order inconsistency and financial-calculation impacts are not covered here.
The report describes the inconsistency as potential ('may return'), so the claim is a consistency obligation rather than an observed incident.
